manaNeeded: {2} if Mister Gutsy doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it
notablePrerequisites: The top card of your library is a nonland card.
description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mister Gutsy, adding {C}{C}.
When Mister Gutsy dies, its second ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Mister Gutsy trigger, creating a number of Junk tokens equal to the number of +1/+1 counters that were on it.
If you created a Junk token, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Junk, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Mister Gutsy from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Mister Gutsy enters the battlefield, Captain Kathryn Janeway trigger, revealing the top card of your library, putting the card back on top of your library, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Mister Gutsy
Repeat.
